components.text: Pyaar ke liye aapka AI wingman

Hi {{1}} 👋

Message samajh nahi aa raha? Dil ki baat kehni hai par shabd nahi mil rahe? LoveMate hai aapka AI wingman, pyaar aur rishton ke liye.

• Confusing messages decode karo, asli matlab jaano
• Perfect confession ya reply likho, English ya Hinglish mein
• Dates aur trips plan karo, couple games khelo, mushkil baatein practise karo

Pehle 7 din Plus free, card ki zaroorat nahi. Uske baad sirf ₹149 mahina.
